method: Independent forward executions first with current skill and raw fixture; no ledger, benchmark answer keys, outcome rubrics or other worker report content read until the four tasks finished. Then complete 28 entrypoints, selected on-demand refs, relevant branch/helper changes and ledger claim classification reviewed.
independence_limits: Same in-session agent/runtime; no controlled baseline/treatment campaign or causal lift inference.
Fixture comments disclose seed failures; they are retained raw inputs.
Shared tree changed during audit; rows bind source hashes and findings record repairs seen during review.
No external source validity/recency, real device, hosted deployment or native cross-host activation proof.

findings.prior_issue: Workflow unconditionally required commit after each cleanup batch, without scope/authorization or preservation of existing staged state.
findings.current_evidence: Current workflow requires a recoverable checkpoint and commit only when authorized with scoped staging.
findings.recommendation: Keep the authorization and existing-index preservation wording.

findings.prior_issue: Completion gate required migration up AND down, and masterplan quality gate required a down-path, despite irreversible/no-down-path rules.
findings.current_evidence: Current matrix accepts safe down, backup restore or forward fix, and masterplan forbids fictional down migration.
findings.recommendation: Keep safe recovery as invariant across all planners/gates.

findings.issue: Every security-sensitive action is ASK ONCE and guidelines 32–34 require stopping dependent work. That topic-wide row conflicts with entrypoint AUTO local edits/tests and explicit authorization reuse, causing an approved local auth regression/remediation to pause.
findings.recommendation: Classify the actual effect and missing authority; permit approved local verification/remediation, and gate production/identity/credential/policy changes as needed.

findings.issue: Browser probe requires about:blank navigation. This session browser tool accepts http/https only; a prescribed unsupported protocol makes a usable browser look unknown and can trigger a policy denial unnecessarily.
findings.confidence: Static instruction conflict with observed tool protocol policy; about:blank itself was not attempted.
findings.recommendation: Use host-supported read-only inventory/observation or permitted task URL; avoid universal navigation scheme.

findings.issue: Unqualified every PASS without screenshots is unverified contradicts permitted HTTP fallback and adverse-conditions per-capability evidence. A verified HTTP denial/persistence check cannot produce a browser screenshot.
findings.recommendation: Require screenshot evidence for visual/rendered claims, while preserving verified HTTP/assertion results and separately unverified missing capture capabilities.

findings.issue: New coverage-floor regression patches SCENARIOS outside ROOT; load_scenarios path.relative_to(ROOT) raises ValueError before coverage assertion. Actual test-upgrade exits 1 with 1 error.
findings.recommendation: Patch ROOT consistently to temporary fixture root with known skills, or create scenarios beneath a controlled temporary ROOT. Preserve loader identity semantics.
